dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はあ〜……面白かったですねえ」
dialogues.en:
"I've never seen a movie like that. It was scary...... but
it was fun."
dialogues.text:
"I've never seen a movie like that. It was scary...... but
it was fun."

dialogues.jp:
適当に入った映画館。適当に選んだ映画は、きっ
ついスプラッタものだった。
dialogues.en: "I'm glad you had fun. Well, would you like to go eat?"
dialogues.text: "I'm glad you had fun. Well, would you like to go eat?"

dialogues.jp:
スプラッタ映画観賞後という悪条件にも関わら
ず、胃袋は補給を訴えている。
dialogues.en:
Even after watching a splatter movie, my stomach still wants
to eat something.
dialogues.text:
Even after watching a splatter movie, my stomach still wants
to eat something.

dialogues.jp: 「何か、食いたいもんある？」
dialogues.en: "Do you have any particular food you want to eat?"
dialogues.text: "Do you have any particular food you want to eat?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……そうですね……」
dialogues.en: "......Let me think......"
dialogues.text: "......Let me think......"

dialogues.jp: 人差し指を唇にあて、思案顔で辺りを見回す。
dialogues.en:
Putting her forefinger on her lips, she looks around,
thinking.
dialogues.text:
Putting her forefinger on her lips, she looks around,
thinking.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……あれなんかは、どうでしょう……」
dialogues.en: "......What about that......?"
dialogues.text: "......What about that......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……犬？　マジで？」
dialogues.en: "......A dog? Are you serious?"
dialogues.text: "......A dog? Are you serious?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「い、いえ、その向こう側の……」
dialogues.en: "N-No, over there......"
dialogues.text: "N-No, over there......"

dialogues.jp:
道の向こう側にあるのは、ファーストフードの
店だった。
dialogues.en: "I know. I was just kidding with you."
dialogues.text: "I know. I was just kidding with you."

dialogues.jp:
ミンチのスプラッタイメージが頭をよぎるが、
まあ、いいや。
dialogues.en: There's a fast-food store on the other side of the road.
dialogues.text: There's a fast-food store on the other side of the road.

dialogues.jp: 「何か、欲しいメニューとかはある？」
dialogues.en:
A bloody meat image from the splatter movie comes unbidden
to my mind, but I try not to think about it.
dialogues.text:
A bloody meat image from the splatter movie comes unbidden
to my mind, but I try not to think about it.

dialogues.jp: 人でごった返している入り口を見ながら｛たず／訊｝ねる。
dialogues.en: "What do you want to have?"
dialogues.text: "What do you want to have?"

dialogues.jp:
スマイルとか頼んだ日には、殴られそうな混雑
ぶりだ。店内で食べるのは無理そうだな……。
dialogues.en:
I ask her, looking at the crowds at the entrance. It's so
crowded that if you ordered a smile, you'd get a punch
instead. It looks like there's no seats left inside the
store.
dialogues.text:
I ask her, looking at the crowds at the entrance. It's so
crowded that if you ordered a smile, you'd get a punch
instead. It looks like there's no seats left inside the
store.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、いえ……特には」
dialogues.en: "Ah, anything will be fine......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, anything will be fine......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「分かった。ほいじゃ、ちょっと待ってて」
dialogues.en: "Okay. You wait here, all right?"
dialogues.text: "Okay. You wait here, all right?"

dialogues.jp:
店へ向かって走ろうとする。……が、服を引っ
張られた。
dialogues.en:
I'm about to run to the McDonald's...... But then my shirt
is pulled back.
dialogues.text:
I'm about to run to the McDonald's...... But then my shirt
is pulled back.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「い、一緒に行きます……」
dialogues.en: "I-I'll go with you......"
dialogues.text: "I-I'll go with you......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……ああ、うん、そうしよっか」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「こういうのも、美味しいですね……」
dialogues.en: "This tastes good......"
dialogues.text: "This tastes good......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「たまに食べる分には悪くないな」
dialogues.en: "It's not bad to eat every once in a while."
dialogues.text: "It's not bad to eat every once in a while."

dialogues.jp:
道ばたにしゃがみ込んで、ハンバーガーをぱく
つく。確かに、こういうのも悪くない。
dialogues.en:
We crouch down at the side of the road and eat our burgers.
It's something new to do, and it's quite fun.
dialogues.text:
We crouch down at the side of the road and eat our burgers.
It's something new to do, and it's quite fun.

dialogues.jp:
家でメイドさんやらせているばっかりじゃ、得
られなかった時間だ。
dialogues.en:
It's something that we would never do together if she kept
working in my house.
dialogues.text:
It's something that we would never do together if she kept
working in my house.

dialogues.jp:
ぼんやりと人の流れを追いながら、ぐいぐい食
べていく。
dialogues.en: We just keep eating, watching people walking by.
dialogues.text: We just keep eating, watching people walking by.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「くすくす……口元、ついてますよ」
dialogues.en: "Teehee...... You have a piece of food on your face,"
dialogues.text: "Teehee...... You have a piece of food on your face,"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ほわ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
紙ナプキンを手に取り、そっと汚れを拭ってく
れた。
dialogues.en: She takes a paper napkin and wipes it off my face.
dialogues.text: She takes a paper napkin and wipes it off my face.

dialogues.jp: 「……ごくん。いやぁ、腹が減ってね」
dialogues.en: "......Mmm... I was very hungry."
dialogues.text: "......Mmm... I was very hungry."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あんまり急ぐと、いつかみたいに、のどに詰
　まってしまいます……」
dialogues.en:
"If you rush your food, you'll get choked again like last
time......"
dialogues.text:
"If you rush your food, you'll get choked again like last
time......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「それもそうだな」
dialogues.en: "You're right."
dialogues.text: "You're right."

dialogues.jp:
ぐいぐいをくいくい程度の勢いに緩める。｛しゃべ／喋｝れ
るようになったので、考えを口にした。
dialogues.en:
I start to eat a little bit slower. Since my mouth isn't
full of food now, I can talk about what I'm thinking.
dialogues.text:
I start to eat a little bit slower. Since my mouth isn't
full of food now, I can talk about what I'm thinking.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、頼子さんさ。やっぱ、一人だと怖い？」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san, will you be still scared to go outside alone?"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san, will you be still scared to go outside alone?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「俺、思ったんだけど、練習とかを積めばいい
　んじゃないかな」
dialogues.en: "I was thinking that you should practice more."
dialogues.text: "I was thinking that you should practice more."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「練習……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Practice......?"
dialogues.text: "Practice......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。慣れれば平気だと思うんだよね。事実、
　前は無理だったのに、今は平気じゃん」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. If you get used to it, I think you'll be fine. You
couldn't go outside at all at first, but today you're fine."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. If you get used to it, I think you'll be fine. You
couldn't go outside at all at first, but today you're fine."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それは……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「段階を踏めばいいと思うんだよな」
dialogues.en: "You just need to practice going outside, little by little."
dialogues.text: "You just need to practice going outside, little by little."

dialogues.jp: コーラで口の中を掃除し、先を続ける。
dialogues.en: I wash my mouth with a sip of Coke and continue,
dialogues.text: I wash my mouth with a sip of Coke and continue,

dialogues.jp:
「初めは、俺が居ても駄目だった。今は、俺が
　ついていれば平気。ほんじゃ、次は一人でも
　大丈夫」
dialogues.en:
"You couldn't do it at first even when you were with me. Now
you can do it when you're with me. So next you'll be able to
do it alone."
dialogues.text:
"You couldn't do it at first even when you were with me. Now
you can do it when you're with me. So next you'll be able to
do it alone."

dialogues.jp:
「……という流れになると思うんだけど、どう
　かな？」
dialogues.en: "I think that's how it goes. What do you think?"
dialogues.text: "I think that's how it goes. What do you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そうかも……しれませんね」
dialogues.en: "Maybe...... you're right."
dialogues.text: "Maybe...... you're right."

dialogues.jp: 俺は真面目な顔をして、頼子さんに向き直った。
dialogues.en: I look at Yoriko-san with a serious look on my face.
dialogues.text: I look at Yoriko-san with a serious look on my face.

dialogues.jp: 「練習、してみようよ」
dialogues.en: "Let's practice."
dialogues.text: "Let's practice."

dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ、１０分後に来るからね」
dialogues.en: "I'll be back in 10 minutes."
dialogues.text: "I'll be back in 10 minutes."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「１０分……ですね」
dialogues.en: "10 minutes......"
dialogues.text: "10 minutes......"

dialogues.jp:
念を押すように、あるいは何かを懇願するよう
に、頼子さんは繰り返した。
dialogues.en:
She repeats, like she's trying to remind me of it or as if
she's pleading something to me.
dialogues.text:
She repeats, like she's trying to remind me of it or as if
she's pleading something to me.

dialogues.jp:
人気のない公園だ。初音島じゃなければたぶん、
夜桜見物で大盛況なはず。
dialogues.en:
We're at an unpopular park. If it wasn't on Hatsune Island,
it'd be a popular park, with lots of people having parties
under the gorgeous cherry blossoms.
dialogues.text:
We're at an unpopular park. If it wasn't on Hatsune Island,
it'd be a popular park, with lots of people having parties
under the gorgeous cherry blossoms.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんはベンチに浅く腰掛けている。１０分
ほど一人きりになってもらおうという作戦だ。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko-san's sitting on the bench uncomfortably. It was my
plan to make her sit alone for 10 minutes.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko-san's sitting on the bench uncomfortably. It was my
plan to make her sit alone for 10 minutes.

dialogues.jp: 「うん。１０分。ま、｛プラマイ／±｝５秒の誤差だよ」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, 10 minutes. I'll be back in 9 minutes and 55 seconds,
okay?"
dialogues.text:
"Yes, 10 minutes. I'll be back in 9 minutes and 55 seconds,
okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「それに、ここが見える場所に居るから」
dialogues.en: "And I'll be somewhere I can see you."
dialogues.text: "And I'll be somewhere I can see you."

dialogues.jp:
元気づけるように笑うのだが、頼子さんは古い
米粒みたいにカチカチだ。
dialogues.en:
I give a smile to cheer her up but she's still as stiff as a
board.
dialogues.text:
I give a smile to cheer her up but she's still as stiff as a
board.

dialogues.jp: 「いいね？」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay?"

dialogues.jp: こくんとうなずく。
dialogues.en: She nods.
dialogues.text: She nods.

dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ、グッドラック」
dialogues.en: "Okay then, good luck!"
dialogues.text: "Okay then, good luck!"

dialogues.jp:
肩をぽんぽんと叩き、１歩後ろに下がり、そし
て、手を振った。
dialogues.en:
I give a pat on her shoulder, slowly step back, and walk
away, waving at her.
dialogues.text:
I give a pat on her shoulder, slowly step back, and walk
away, waving at her.

dialogues.jp: 「……到着、と。はい、丁度１０分だよ」
dialogues.en: "......I'm back. Exactly 10 minutes."
dialogues.text: "......I'm back. Exactly 10 minutes."

dialogues.jp:
遠目からでは分からなかったのだが、頼子さん
の身体は小刻みに震えていた。
dialogues.en: I hasn't noticed from a distance, but she's shaking.
dialogues.text: I hasn't noticed from a distance, but she's shaking.

dialogues.jp:
そして、間近でなければ聞こえるはずのない、
小さな嗚咽。
dialogues.en:
And she's crying so quietly that I could never hear it if I
wasn't very close to her face.
dialogues.text:
And she's crying so quietly that I could never hear it if I
wasn't very close to her face.

dialogues.jp: 「ほ、ほら、泣かないで、頼子さん」
dialogues.en: "H-Hey, please don't cry, Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "H-Hey, please don't cry, Yoriko-san."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、は、はい……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, o-okay......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, o-okay......"

dialogues.jp: 目をこすりながら、何とか応える。
dialogues.en:
Rubbing her eyes, she barely answers. I feel so sorry and
hold her tight.
dialogues.text:
Rubbing her eyes, she barely answers. I feel so sorry and
hold her tight.

dialogues.jp:
痛ましくて、俺は、頼子さんの身体をぎゅっと
やった。
dialogues.en:
"......I'm sorry. I guess 10 minutes was too long to start
with."
dialogues.text:
"......I'm sorry. I guess 10 minutes was too long to start
with."

dialogues.jp:
「……悪い、ちょっと、１０分っていう設定が
　駄目だったみたいだ」
dialogues.en: "I should have shortened the time. I'm really sorry."
dialogues.text: "I should have shortened the time. I'm really sorry."

dialogues.jp: 「もっと、短くすれば良かった。悪かった」
dialogues.en: I feel her shaking her head against my chest.
dialogues.text: I feel her shaking her head against my chest.

dialogues.jp: 顔を振る感覚が、胸元に伝わってくる。
dialogues.en: "Or...... we don't have to do this anymore."
dialogues.text: "Or...... we don't have to do this anymore."

dialogues.jp: 「それとも……練習、止めるか？」
dialogues.en: Again, I feel her shaking her head.
dialogues.text: Again, I feel her shaking her head.

dialogues.jp: 再び、顔を振る感覚。それも、すぐに。
dialogues.en: "Okay...... then we'll keep trying."
dialogues.text: "Okay...... then we'll keep trying."

dialogues.jp: 「うん……じゃ、がんばろ」
dialogues.en: This time she nods.
dialogues.text: This time she nods.

dialogues.jp: 今度は縦に。
dialogues.en: She needs firm warmth more than words now.
dialogues.text: She needs firm warmth more than words now.

dialogues.jp: 言葉よりも、今は温もりだな。
dialogues.en: With an embarrassing thought, I hold her tighter in my arms.
dialogues.text: With an embarrassing thought, I hold her tighter in my arms.

dialogues.jp:
そんな、こっ恥ずかしいことを思いながら、俺
は、抱きしめる力を強くした。

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「く、苦しいです……」
dialogues.en: "I-I can't breathe......"
dialogues.text: "I-I can't breathe......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あう……そりゃ失礼」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "Oh...... I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp: ◆最初の練習◆
デートはとても楽しかった。
dialogues.en: "Ahh...... That was fun."
dialogues.text: "Ahh...... That was fun."

dialogues.jp:
ただ、まだ一人で外にいるのは怖いという頼子
さんに、俺は練習を提案した。
dialogues.en: "R-Really?"
dialogues.text: "R-Really?"

dialogues.jp:
そして、時間を決めて、その間は一人でいる。
二人でそんな練習をした。
dialogues.en:
We sort of happened to walk past a movie theater and I
picked a movie at random, which turned out to be a very gory
horror movie.
dialogues.text:
We sort of happened to walk past a movie theater and I
picked a movie at random, which turned out to be a very gory
horror movie.
